items.title: Accelerate design space exploration with AI on AWS
items.summary: Engineers rarely validate more than a handful of designs because each physics-based simulation can take days to months. This post walks through a multi-agent Design Space Explorer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and the Strands Agents SDK that uses generative AI and ML surrogate models to evaluate car designs across disciplines in minutes.
items.creator: Sridhar Mahadevan
